_comment: Non-secret config. The KEYS live in the n8n credential store - 'AWS S3' (type aws) and 'Buffer API' (type httpHeaderAuth) - and are edited at http://localhost:5678 > Credentials, never here.

s3._region: Must match the region set on the 'AWS S3' credential. The credential's region signs the request; this one builds the public URL.
s3._publicBaseUrl: Optional. Set if the bucket is behind CloudFront or a custom domain; otherwise the plain S3 URL is used.

buffer._channelId: From your Buffer channel URL - publish.buffer.com/channels/<THIS>/schedule. Not a secret.
